description: Update a calendar event (partial) — reschedule (start_at/end_at) or edit title/location/description/all_day/lead_id. Get the event_id from find_calendar_event; an id belonging to a meeting is not accepted here, use update_meeting for those. Times without an offset are read as wall-clock time in the event's timezone (pass timezone to override). Changes sync to Google if linked (user calendar).

event_id.description: ID of the event to change

name: update_calendar_event
